title: How to request coverage without a scavenger hunt
excerpt: A staffing request should name the unit, the shift, and the headcount in one pass.
body:
A staffing request should name the unit, the shift, and the headcount in one pass.

Start with the service you need, then the specialty and the city. The form on the contact page is built for that order.

title: Designing a shift grid a unit can actually staff
excerpt: Night, day, rotating, and weekend are different products. Write them that way.
body:
Night, day, rotating, and weekend are different products. Write them that way.

A weekend radiologic role is not a night ICU role. Filters on the job board use those words as stable values so a label change does not break a shared link.
